architecture_hypothesis.name: clause_local_bidirectional_modifier_binding
architecture_hypothesis.statement: A source-grounded modifier can precede or follow its economic action. Candidate-9 will resolve constraints and other authority-bearing modifiers within an explicit source clause, rather than treating preceding-action order as semantic scope. Resolution must be unique and exact-source grounded; ambiguity or cross-clause competition fails closed.
allowed_change_surface: new Candidate-9 visible-development runner and workflow infrastructure

prompts.policy: frozen for the preregistered visible iteration

iteration_policy.early_stop: Use the frozen mathematical reachability policy; stop provider calls when passing becomes impossible.
iteration_policy.provider_limited: Preserve sanitized evidence and do not classify as a semantic failure or hammer the provider.
iteration_policy.semantic_failure: Diagnose only from permitted visible evidence; make the smallest general correction and never retry unchanged semantics until lucky.

stopping_rule: No provider development call may occur until this preregistration is committed on candidate9-development and deterministic validation passes. Later gates remain locked until each preceding retained semantic artifact genuinely passes.
